## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology, Utilities, Consumer Staples). Mixed signals: narrow upside concentration in large-cap tech (multiple ABOVE TREND names) while several mega-caps show 1W/1M divergence, supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: INTC (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +21.71% | 1M: +64.22%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong on a 1W basis: XOM (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -10.42%) RECOVERY, CVX (1W: +0.83% | 1M: -11.07%) RECOVERY. Utilities showing pockets of strength: CEG (1W: +9.60% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication weakest: CHTR (1W: -28.64% | 1M: -20.09%) BELOW TREND and sector -5.65% 1W. Consumer Discretionary lagging: RCL (1W: -8.29% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND and sector -3.28% 1W. Healthcare soft on the week: JNJ (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -5.81%) BELOW TREND and sector -2.84% 1W.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +21.71% | 1M: +64.22%) ABOVE TREND; TXN (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +39.34%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.60% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentrated in Technology (3/5) — Growth/momentum tilt but breadth is limited.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -8.07% | 1M: +7.62%) CORRECTION; RCL (1W: -8.29% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -9.27% | 1M: -9.14%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -10.11% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select tech and discretionary names — reduce exposure to these laggards.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: INTC (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +21.71% | 1M: +64.22%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +39.34%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, JPM, V, MA show 1W vs 1M sign differences) — tactical follow-through required, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but momentum concentrated: NVDA (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +16.08%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.99% | 1M: +5.82%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: +1.99% with narrow leadership and pockets of heavy weakness (ACN, NOW, IBM). Sector breadth: positive on the week but internals mixed.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft on the week: JPM (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +7.39%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +1.35%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +1.31%) CORRECTION. Financials sector 1W: -1.91% and showing internal weakness — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Dispersed with a clear outlier: UNH (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%) ABOVE TREND is a strong performer while JNJ (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -5.81%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -3.20%) BELOW TREND show weakness. Sector 1W: -2.84% and breadth is weak.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Maintain neutral positioning: favor names showing confirmed strength (INTC, AMD, NVDA, UNH, TXN) and reduce exposure to clear laggards (ACN, NOW, IBM, CHTR). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak sector breadth; monitor mega-cap divergences before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; UNH (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%) ABOVE TREND — confirm margin story. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -28.64% | 1M: -20.09%) BELOW TREND; LMT (1W: -11.69% | 1M: -18.17%) BELOW TREND — risk of continued downside.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W +1.99%) — watch whether leadership broadens beyond a few names. BEARISH: Communication (-5.65%) and Consumer Discretionary (-3.28%) where downside is concentrated and stress could persist.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: hold above recent highs to confirm continuation (monitor 1M trend confirmation). AAPL: reclaim positive 1W to exit CORRECTION and signal renewed leadership. INTC: follow-through above this week’s gap to validate ABOVE TREND momentum. UNH: hold weekly gains to confirm durable strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNP (+60): News — record Q1 margins and efficiency gains; UNP (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +12.43%) ABOVE TREND — price confirms sentiment. DUK (+75): NRC license renewal headline; DUK not in detailed price table here — monitor for confirmation before repositioning.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMD (-45): News — AI capex worries; AMD (1W: +21.71% | 1M: +64.22%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverges from price, signals distribution risk to watch. AMGN (-75): FDA withdrawal risk; AMGN not in detailed price table here — treat as headline-driven downside risk until price confirms.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +92.72%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +32.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence between news sentiment and price in names like AMD (-45 sentiment vs ABOVE TREND performance) and multiple mega-cap 1W/1M sign conflicts — watch for trend breaks.
